_about: High or critical npm advisories CI's dependency-audit allows for now (scripts/audit_check.mjs). Each entry names the advisory, why it is allowed, who decided, and the date to look again; on or after that date CI fails until someone rechecks it and moves the date or removes the entry. Any advisory not listed still fails CI.

allow.why: A ReDoS in picomatch, which reaches this repository only through vite and vitest (build and test tooling, never served). The advisory covers every version and no fixed release exists; npm's only offered fix downgrades vitest to 3.1.4, a breaking major. Remove this entry once picomatch ships a fix and npm audit fix takes it.
allow.decided: Krish, 2026-11-17, in a Claude Code session: allow it and recheck weekly
